item.description:

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
500 PM PDT Tue Jul 28 2026

For the eastern and central North Pacific east of 180 longitude:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center is issuing advisories on Tropical
Storm Fausto, located in the Central Pacific a few hundred miles
east-northeast of the Hawaiian Islands, and on Hurricane Genevieve,
located several hundred miles southwest of the southern tip of the
Baja California Peninsula.

Tropical cyclone formation is not expected during the next 7 days.

$$
Forecaster Kelly

item.title: Summary for Hurricane Genevieve (EP2/EP072026)
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
item.description: ...GENEVIEVE STRENGTHENS AGAIN... As of 5:00 PM PDT Tue Jul 28 the center of Genevieve was located near 18.2, -117.2 with movement WNW at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 948 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 130 mph.

item.title: Hurricane Genevieve Public Advisory Number 19
item.description:
Issued at 500 PM PDT Tue Jul 28 2026 
015 
WTPZ32 KNHC 290000
TCPEP2
 
BULLETIN
Hurricane Genevieve Special Advisory Number  19
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL       EP072026
500 PM PDT Tue Jul 28 2026
 
...GENEVIEVE STRENGTHENS AGAIN...
 
 
SUMMARY OF 500 PM PDT...0000 UTC...INFORMATION
----------------------------------------------
LOCATION...18.2N 117.2W
ABOUT 575 MI...920 KM WSW OF THE SOUTHERN TIP OF BAJA CALIFORNIA
MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...130 MPH...215 KM/H
PRESENT MOVEMENT...WNW OR 290 DEGREES AT 9 MPH...15 KM/H
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE...948 MB...28.00 INCHES
 
 
WATCHES AND WARNINGS
--------------------
There are no coastal watches or warnings in effect.
 
 
DISCUSSION AND OUTLOOK
----------------------
At 500 PM PDT (0000 UTC), the center of Hurricane Genevieve was
located near latitude 18.2 North, longitude 117.2 West. Genevieve is
moving toward the west-northwest near 9 mph (15 km/h), and this
general motion is expected during the next few days.
 
Maximum sustained winds have increased to near 130 mph (215 km/h) 
with higher gusts.  Genevieve is a category 4 hurricane on the 
Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale. Some fluctuations in intensity 
are possible over the next day or so, then a weakening trend should 
begin thereafter.
 
Hurricane-force winds extend outward up to 45 miles (75 km) from the
center and tropical-storm-force winds extend outward up to 125 miles
(205 km).
 
The estimated minimum central pressure is 948 mb (28.00 inches).
 
 
HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND
----------------------
SURF:  Swells generated by Genevieve are affecting portions of the
southwestern coast of Mexico and the Baja California Peninsula.
These swells are likely to persist for a few more days, and could
cause life-threatening surf and rip current conditions. Please
consult products from your local weather office.
 
 
NEXT ADVISORY
-------------
Next complete advisory at 800 PM PDT.
 
$$
Forecaster Kelly
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)

item.title: Hurricane Genevieve Forecast Discussion Number 19
item.description:
Issued at 500 PM PDT Tue Jul 28 2026 
216 
WTPZ42 KNHC 290003
TCDEP2
 
Hurricane Genevieve Special Discussion Number  19
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL       EP072026
500 PM PDT Tue Jul 28 2026
 
This is a special advisory to modify the current intensity of the 
hurricane and update the intensity forecast. Recent satellite 
imagery shows that deep convection has continue to wrap around the 
center of Genevieve this afternoon. Latest intensity estimates from 
UW-CIMSS have increased from 105 to 122 kt the last several hours. 
Given the improved satellite presentation the intensity is raised to 
115 kt, and Genevieve has strengthened into a category 4 hurricane 
again.

The intensity forecast has been updated due to the revised current 
intensity. Some fluctuations in intensity are possible the next day 
or so, before a weakening trend is anticipated as the system moves 
over progressively cooler sea-surface temperatures and into a drier 
mid-level environment. The NHC intensity forecast lies above the 
latest model guidance in the short-term and then trends towards 
the consensus aids beyond day 2 through the end of the forecast 
period.The track forecast is unchanged from the previous advisory.
